in_urdu.name: رہف
in_urdu.long_meaning: रہف نام کا مطلب ہے، ایک نادر نام ہے جو اس کے معانی کے لیے جانی جاتی ہے۔ اس نام کا تعلق Arabic زبان سے ہے اور اس کے مطلب ہے، "ذو النصر، الرفيع، القليل"۔ یہ نام ایک نادر نام ہے اور اس کا استعمال بہت کم ہوتا ہے۔ لہذا، یہ نام ہمارے لیے ایک بہت ہی اچھا نام ہے جسے ہم اپنی لڑکی کے لیے منتخب کرسکتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रहफ
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहफ नाम का अर्थ है निसर, उच्च, कम. यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है "धन्य, उच्च, कम". यह नाम एक दुर्लभ नाम है और इसका उपयोग बहुत कम होता है। इसलिए, यह नाम हमारे लिए एक बहुत ही अच्छा नाम है जिसे हम अपनी बेटी के लिए चुन सकते हैं।

in_pashto.name: ړهف
in_pashto.long_meaning: ړهف نوم دې ته پرښوټي، دې ته ډېر ښه، دې ته لږ نوم دی. دې نوم له عربي ژبې څخه راغلی دی او دې ته پرښوټي، ډېر ښه، لږ په معنا دی. دې نوم یو دې ته پرښوټي نوم دی چې دې ته ډېر ښه، دې ته لږ، دې ته پرښوټي په معنا دی. دې نوم یو دې ته پرښوټي نوم دی چې دې ته ډېر ښه، دې ته لږ، دې ته پرښوټي په معنا دی.

in_english.name: Rahf
in_english.long_meaning: Rahf is an Arabic name that means "opposite of Qasst, noble, few". The name is derived from the root of the Arabic word "Rahf", which means "opposite of Qasst, noble, few". In Islamic tradition, the name Rahf is significant as it is associated with the concept of "opposite of Qasst, noble, few". The name is considered to be a noble and few name, hence its significance in Islamic tradition is high. In modern times, the name Rahf is gaining popularity as a unique and beautiful name for girls. It is a name that reflects the values of nobility, fewness, and opposite of Qasst, which are highly valued in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic tradition, the name "Rahf" is believed to have a significant cultural impact due to its association with rain. Rain is seen as a source of life and renewal in Islamic Culture. In the Quran, verse 24:43 states " indeed, it is We who have sent down the Qur'an in Arabic, and We will preserve it for you. Indeed, in this is a reminders for those who know." The word "Rain" in Arabic "An-Nar" appears 38 times in the Quran, emphasizing its importance and connection to Islamic beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Rahf" holds spiritual significance for Muslims as it is believed to evoke the gentle shower of Allah's blessings andmercy. The Arabic root ' Raf' means, 'to relieve from difficulty' and 'to make easy', which reflects the spiritual comfort and ease that comes with receiving Allah's blessings. Additionally, the presence of the letter "Ra" in the name is considered to have mystical meaning, representing the Divine Throne ( Arsh) and the manifestation of Allah's mercy. Therefore, the name "Rahf" serves as a constant reminder of Allah's care and companionship in times of adversity and hardship.
